title: C# tutorial: types, classes, collections, LINQ and async — cv.cm
description: Learn C# in one page: run Hello world with the .NET SDK, types, control flow, classes, records, List and Dictionary, LINQ, async and exceptions.
answer: C# is a statically typed, object-oriented language from Microsoft that runs on .NET, a free, cross-platform runtime for Windows, macOS and Linux. Install the .NET SDK, run `dotnet new console`, and `dotnet run` prints "Hello, World!". The core ideas are classes and records, generic collections such as `List<T>` and `Dictionary<K, V>`, LINQ queries, `async`/`await`, pattern matching and exceptions.

sections.h: What C# is and what it is used for
body: C# (pronounced "C sharp") was designed at Microsoft by a team led by Anders Hejlsberg and first released in 2002. It is standardized by Ecma (ECMA-334) and developed in the open together with .NET. C# is used for web APIs and sites (ASP.NET Core), Windows desktop apps, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps (.NET MAUI), cloud services, and games: the Unity engine uses C# for game scripts. Its syntax is in the C family, so it looks familiar to Java, C++ and JavaScript developers.
Download the .NET SDK from dot.net and check it with `dotnet --version`. Create and run a console project:

body.code:
dotnet new console -o HelloApp
cd HelloApp
dotnet run
# Hello, World!

body: The template creates `Program.cs`, which uses top-level statements, so no class or `Main` method is needed for a small program:

Every variable has a static type. `var` lets the compiler infer it from the value. Value types (numbers, `bool`, `struct`) hold their data directly; reference types (`string`, classes, arrays) refer to an object.
`$"..."` is an interpolated string. New projects enable nullable reference types, so the compiler warns when a value that may be `null` is used without a check.
The `switch` expression and the `or` pattern are part of C# pattern matching. Methods can have default parameter values, named arguments (`Greet(name: "Lin")`) and expression bodies with `=>`.
Classes have fields, properties (fields with get and set logic) and methods. A `record` is a type whose equality is based on its values, ideal for immutable data.
Type declarations must come after top-level statements in the same file. Classes support single inheritance (`class Savings : Account`) and any number of interfaces.

Generic collections in `System.Collections.Generic` are the everyday data structures. LINQ (Language Integrated Query) adds methods such as `Where`, `Select`, `OrderBy` and `GroupBy` to every collection.
Other common collections are `HashSet<T>` for unique items, `Queue<T>`, `Stack<T>` and fixed-size arrays such as `int[]`.

C# introduced the `async`/`await` model that many languages later adopted. An `async` method returns a `Task` and can `await` slow operations, such as web requests or file reads, without blocking a thread.
`Task.WhenAll` runs both requests at the same time and waits for both. The `using var` declaration disposes the `HttpClient` at the end of the scope.
Errors are exceptions. Catch specific types first, and use `finally` or `using` for cleanup. The `TryParse` pattern avoids exceptions for input that is often invalid.

sections.h: A small complete program: word frequency
body: Replace `Program.cs` in a console project with this code, then run `dotnet run -- notes.txt`.

Top-level statements can read command-line `args` and return an exit code. `System.IO`, `System.Linq` and `System.Collections.Generic` are imported automatically through implicit usings in new projects.

body.note: Do not block on asynchronous code with `.Result` or `.Wait()`. It can deadlock in UI and older ASP.NET apps and wastes threads elsewhere. Use `await` all the way up.

ul: Using `double` for money; use `decimal` to avoid binary rounding errors.
Ignoring nullable warnings, which then become `NullReferenceException` at runtime.
Modifying a `List<T>` inside a `foreach` over the same list, which throws `InvalidOperationException`.
Creating a new `HttpClient` for every request in a long-running app. Reuse one instance or use `IHttpClientFactory`.
Forgetting that LINQ queries run lazily: the query runs again each time it is enumerated unless you call `ToList()`.

body: Microsoft Learn has the official C# documentation, including a tour of the language and interactive tutorials. Then learn ASP.NET Core for web APIs, Entity Framework Core for databases, or Unity for games, and use xUnit or NUnit for tests. Visual Studio, VS Code with the C# Dev Kit, and JetBrains Rider are the common editors.

faq.a: No. Modern .NET runs on Windows, macOS and Linux, and C# apps can be deployed to Linux servers and containers. Only some desktop UI frameworks, such as WPF and Windows Forms, are Windows-only.

faq.q: What is the difference between C# and .NET?
faq.a: C# is the programming language. .NET is the runtime and libraries that compile and run C# code (and also F# and Visual Basic).

Yes, in many ways: both are statically typed, garbage-collected, object-oriented languages with C-style syntax. C# adds features such as properties, LINQ, `async`/`await`, value-type structs and records.

faq.q: Is C# good for game development?
faq.a: Yes. Unity, one of the most widely used game engines, uses C# for game scripts, and the Godot engine also supports C#.
